_readme: Optional descriptions for the photos in this folder. Keys are filenames. Every field is optional — anything you leave out gets a sensible default. "alt" is for screen readers; "caption" is the short line on gallery tiles; "story" is the sentence or two shown under Photo of the Day. Set "feature": true on the photo you want used as the hero.

scoopy-bowtie.jpg.alt: Scoopy, a Sun Conure with a golden-orange head and emerald wing tips, wearing a small red bow tie and tilting his head at the camera
scoopy-bowtie.jpg.caption: Dressed for the occasion. No occasion.
scoopy-bowtie.jpg.story: He has decided the bow tie suits him, and on this point he will not be taking questions.
